changelog: Added decoupled Tri-Regional Climate system (South temperate, Central desert basin, North alpine) with smooth 200m buffer blending.
Implemented human thermodynamics 30-minute cold exposure accumulator, cold warning toast, adaptive blue vignette, and heat source warming.
Added real-time native 2D Flight Instruments HUD for planes and helicopters (barometric altimeter MSL/QNH, variometer, crosswind, turbulence, windshear warning).
Added interactive dynamic storm cell spawner directly on the Doppler radar canvas with localized in-game storms.
Enforced strict night-only astronomical occurrences for Aurora Borealis and Perseid meteor showers with live astronomical forecasting.
Integrated interactive 4-step Zone Tutorial guide in the admin management interface.
100% in-game live configuration and toggles for all new atmospheric systems without server restart.
